inventoryReview: Reviewed three generated production sources: Verification/DataPageKernel.g.cs, IndexMutationKernel.g.cs and UsageMapKernel.g.cs. They contain deterministic pinned-Dafny native primitive operations without runtime support, package references, I/O or ownership authority. Existing DataPageRows, IndexPageCodec and UsageMap supply the executing adapters; source classifications elsewhere remain unchanged. New test and benchmark sources are evidence only. The exact manifest, generated-source/caller discovery and retained failure inputs cover all five kernels. Native signed long preserves the existing page-number domain without narrowing. Public parser, tree edit, statement rollback, native compatibility and platform durability obligations remain scoped in the design and open plan. Existing IndexSeekFilter and CompactRowRelocationMap now invoke reviewed generated decisions; no production source paths, modules, runtime requirements or dependencies were added. Numeric admission remains pure query policy at priority2; relocation remains a bounded B4 ledger decision without reclamation authority.

Reviewed maximal index prefix scanning, bounded entry capacity/progress, direct fixed-position header/prefix/bookmark/child/boundary byte extraction under the unchanged ghost byte law, finite payload composition and sentinel/free-space finalization. Pointer widths/layouts are unchanged; stable list acquisition, metadata preflight and exact key-suffix copy remain premises. Reviewed exact ordered usage-bitmap selection, direct cursor/member-mask/status/computed-page-base outputs, exact byte-mask selection and byte-index zero skipping, decreasing rank, tolerant invalid-member skipping and strict first-failure prefix retention. Production establishes range admission once, retains an admitted byte-aligned cursor and immutable array, and appends selected bits in order through a compact partial-mask loop or full-mask straight appends before terminal refusal handling; list effects and reference-page cancellation/return remain contracts. The shared index-entry scan must bind a found non-sentinel boundary to the negated exhaustion statement under its original bounded-array contract. Existing recovery/replacement/descriptor/visited/frame/lifecycle boundaries remain documented in formal-verification.md and their model sources; no additional recovery or page-release authority follows. Reviewed outward nearest-even integral/Currency/Decimal/Single bounds with exact equality, lossless comparison domains, overflow/NaN refusal and signed-zero rank admission. The original residual predicate and descending-range refusal remain. Reviewed monotone native bookmark admission, injective ordered destinations, overflow-safe long pivot and exact half-open search transitions in the immutable disk ledger. Unsigned distance division preserves the signed API without compiler runtime helpers. Repeated cleanup interruptions retain the selected image/decision and reacquire recorded authority only while its receipt survives. Exact reviewed inputs also bind predicate operator codes, lossless widening, scalar conversion, native key encoding, descending-range/encode refusal and bookmark representation to the numeric/relocation adapter contracts.

Bitmap tests compare every byte pattern and signed bounds against independent expansion, strict retained prefixes, reference-page return and cancellation. Focused local checks provide development feedback; settled-main CI, target/analyzer/package/trimming/NativeAOT and hosted measurements remain required. Original-algorithm microbenchmark controls and paired existing workloads retain performance evidence without treating generated code as a timing theorem. Existing cited recovery, lifecycle, parser, native and fault-injection evidence remains applicable within its stated scope. Independent stable key buckets cover every three-existing/two-added splice run over four mixed-length keys and every removal subset, including tie order and unchanged inputs. Independent visited-set traces compare exact membership/count and production adapter decisions through repeated collisions, duplicates, zero inputs and growth; exact-budget colliding chains preserve payloads and lease handoff. Concurrent lease disposal/acquisition checks exactly-once accounting and retained reader/producer ownership; delayed lease loads refuse stale cache publication while live images survive invalidation/disposal. Independent encoded-key oracles cover supported orders and both Decimal key forms, with an explicit legacy-descending cross-sign negative control and planner refusal/equality-prefix tests. Public indexed-versus-scan regressions retain exact positive/negative zero bits. Relocation tests cover native endpoints, independent sparse mappings, logarithmic record reads and unchanged key identity. Repeated cleanup tests check receipt bytes, fresh-generation reconstruction, live exclusion and successor ownership. Colliding-chain cancellation tests cover growth boundaries and row-lease release. Exact settled-main CI remains required.

reviews.conformance: Focused verify-proofs, proof-review and formal-workflow regressions cover new module packaging/provenance, wrong namespaces, runtime/descriptor rejection, five-kernel dispatch, signed-long admission/refusal, exact inlining declarations, complete failure snapshots and new callers. Fresh integrity-pinned Dafny/Z3 complete-inventory verification, clean audit, both mandatory negative controls and generated freshness are required for this settled source. Ordinary CI independently gates every selected runtime/library/analyzer/trim combination; hosted benchmarks establish their measured workloads only. Selected coverage and complexity diagnostics refuse before supplemental execution for wrong Dafny/Z3 pins, failed inventory verification/audit, either negative-control failure and stale output from each of the five generated kernels; exact failure receipts remain required. The survey maps all admitted proof boundaries to independent unit or production conformance evidence without promoting finite tests to full refinement or storage guarantees.  Supplemental survey source statements and concrete code mappings received independent review. Upstream proof artifacts were not rerun; this is literature evidence, not new repository verification, native interoperability, platform qualification or performance acceptance. Complete pinned verification/audit and deterministic native generation cover every normal source and registered module. The unsigned relocation pivot was reviewed after the unchanged runtime-support guard rejected signed Euclidean division. Generated long-value methods remain textually unchanged after ghost-meter erasure. Test links identify coverage; execution, native interoperability, platform qualification and timing retain their independent exact-source evidence requirements.
reviews.remainingAssumptions: Specification adequacy, Dafny/Z3 soundness, compiler projection, C# compiler and CLR/JIT/AOT remain trusted. Source hashes establish review freshness rather than reviewer identity, adapter refinement, actual I/O effects, native interoperability or physical durability. Sequence composition proves declared effects, while their C#/BCL implementation and complete public operation composition retain explicit obligations. Target compatibility and performance require independent builds, tests and hosted measurements. External literature retains its own atomicity, root-completeness, language/runtime, checksum and primitive hypotheses. Those hypotheses do not replace the repository torn-write model, native semantics, actual CLR effect contracts or independent timing/storage qualification. Resource meters count destination probes, rehash source-loop iterations and logical uint slots, not every instruction, CLR allocation success/zeroing time, object headers, GC/JIT roots, locator/cache/destination storage or synchronous cancellation latency. Native order and immutable stream effects remain explicit contracts. Existing compiler/projection/runtime trust and complete public C# correspondence obligations remain; no upstream literature artifact or unchecked assumption is imported.
